name: Captain Grayson
summary: At Westfall Lighthouse, Captain Grayson keeps watch over the beacon that failed him. His ship smashed against the dark coastline, and now he tends the light so other sailors will not meet his fate.

sections.title: A Life Cut Short by the Rocks
sections.body: Captain Grayson once sailed the southern seas of the Eastern Kingdoms as a ship’s captain. One night, the lighthouse fire went dark as his vessel neared Westfall’s jagged shoals. The ship struck the rocks, and Grayson died with it. He awoke as an earthbound phantom, trapped upon the coast.

sections.title: Tragedy at the Beacon
sections.body: In death, Captain Grayson went to Westfall Lighthouse, hoping to learn what waited beyond life. There he saw Old Murk-Eye, a notorious murloc, drive away the keeper and his family. The brave keepers returned to rekindle the flame, but Old Murk-Eye rallied the surrounding murlocs and led a second, brutal slaughter. Grayson could only watch as the family was butchered.

sections.title: A Ghostly Vigil
sections.body: With the keepers dead and Westfall crumbling under neglect, Captain Grayson bears the beacon’s solemn burden on his spectral shoulders. He asks passing travelers to gather fuel for the great flame. He also seeks vengeance for the slaughtered family: hunt down Old Murk-Eye and drive back the coastal murlocs.

faq.answer: Captain Grayson is a human ghost pirate at Westfall Lighthouse. His ship smashed against the coast when the beacon went dark, and he now tends the light to protect passing sailors.

aliases: how did grayson become a ghost
faq.answer: Captain Grayson died when his pirate vessel struck the treacherous rocks along Westfall’s shore. The lighthouse was dark that night, leaving him and his crew without warning before the ship was torn apart.

faq.q: What happened to the real lighthouse keeper?
faq.answer: Coastal murlocs attacked the keeper and his family. The brave family escaped the first assault and returned to relight the beacon, but Old Murk-Eye rallied a second raid and slaughtered them before Grayson’s eyes.
Old Murk-Eye is a cunning, vicious murloc chieftain on the Westfall shoreline. He led the attack that killed the lighthouse keeper’s family and threatens anyone trying to keep the beacon lit.

faq.q: Why does Grayson want the lighthouse kept lit?
faq.answer: Grayson drowned when the coastline was pitch black, and sees keeping the lighthouse lit as his solemn duty in the afterlife. He wants to spare other sailors the same fate on the shoals.

faq.q: Is Captain Grayson hostile to adventurers?
faq.answer: No. Though Grayson was a pirate in life, he bears no ill will toward the living. He has witnessed too much slaughter and seeks peace and help tending the flame.

angles.text: With the Defias Brotherhood choking Westfall and Stormwind neglecting its borders, Alliance travelers must answer Grayson’s plea and keep the lighthouse flame burning.
As a paladin, you can honor your sacred duty to defend the helpless and drive back the murderous murlocs by helping Grayson, though he is an undead spirit.
As a priest, you can offer solace to Grayson’s restless soul. Guilt and grief anchor his spirit after he watched an innocent family die.
